data.body:
**P2 — Collect executions that produced no diagnostics**

Final collection discovers execution ARNs only from parsed `LMI_TEST` events. An accepted invocation whose ARN was saved under `artifacts/invocations` but which crashed or timed out before logging is therefore omitted from status and history collection—precisely when that evidence is needed. Merge ARNs from completed invocation artifacts with diagnostic-derived ARNs and add a no-diagnostics regression test.
